Slop EML · free, in your browser

Convert an EML email to PDF

Keep an email as a PDF for your records or a case file. Slop EML writes the headers and the text of the message to a clean A4 PDF.

Convert EML to PDF

How to do it

  1. Drop the .eml file on the page.
  2. Choose Convert to PDF.
  3. Keep the option to list the attachment names at the end, or untick it.
  4. Choose Save PDF.

To keep the HTML layout and pictures instead, choose Print and pick Save as PDF in your browser's print dialog.

Your files stay on this device: Slop EML runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Does the PDF keep the email's design?

Convert to PDF keeps the headers and the text, with links as text. For the HTML layout and images, use Print and save as PDF from the print dialog.

Are attachments put inside the PDF?

No. Their names are listed at the end; download the attachments themselves from the message.

What about characters the PDF cannot show?

The PDF uses a standard font. Characters it cannot draw are replaced and counted, and the app tells you how many.
